record.question: When students do not have time to read a novel before class, they read __________.
record.explanation: Answer B: a synopsis. A synopsis summarizes a novel for students who have not read it. Independent check: A synopsis is a brief summary of a novel’s plot, suitable when time is short. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/synopsis.
